final_description: Use this skill to make a repository work well for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Devin, Codex). Trigger it whenever someone wants a repo prepared, organized, or standardized for AI agents — or complains that agents lose context between sessions, redo finished work, don't know where they stopped, or invent different rules each time; or wants several agents/teammates following the same rules. Also trigger on requests for AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, session protocol, init.sh, SESSION_STATE.md, TASKS.md, handoff, definition of done, agent gate/pre-commit hooks, OpenSpec, WIP=1, task groups with checkpoints, or "harness engineering" — in Portuguese or English, and even without the word "harness". It inspects the repo's stack and commands and writes the whole harness (instructions + enforcement). Skip it for conceptual questions with no target repo, for debugging an existing hook or CI pipeline, and for ordinary technical docs (README, ARCHITECTURE).
